title: The Cost of a Higher Wall

paragraphs.english: The supplies from town changed the house. Yang connected the solar panel to the new batteries and gave the family quiet power for lamps and radio charging. The fuel was saved for the water pump and heavy tools. Shuo and his father used steel from the animal shed to enhance the gate. They raised the weakest section of wall with stone and filled a drainage channel before the next rain. Every improvement required labor, food, and hours of winter daylight.
paragraphs.chinese: 从镇上带回的物资改变了山屋。洋把太阳能板接入新电池，为照明和收音机充电提供安静电力。燃料则留给抽水泵和重型工具。硕与父亲用牲口棚钢材加强大门，又用石头抬高最薄弱的墙段，并赶在下雨前挖好排水沟。每项改造都需要劳动、食物和冬季有限的日照时间。

paragraphs.english: The family began to feel stronger, and that confidence created a flaw. Their mother carried a bucket of mortar toward the wall after Shuo had asked her to rest. A wet board moved under her foot. She fell against a cut sheet of metal and opened a deep wound below her knee. The bleeding stopped under pressure, but the wound needed cleaning, stitches, antibiotics, and several days without heavy work.
paragraphs.chinese: 一家人开始觉得自己更强了，而这种信心也制造了缺陷。硕已经让母亲休息，她却仍提着一桶砂浆走向围墙。一块湿木板在脚下滑动，她跌向切开的金属板，小腿下方被划出一道深伤口。按压后出血停止，但伤口需要清洗、缝合、抗生素，以及数日不能从事重体力劳动。

paragraphs.english: Shuo felt immediate regret. The metal should have been covered, and the path should have been kept clear. His mother refused to blame him. She directed Yang while he washed the wound with clean water, then closed it with supplies from the clinic. DQ lay beside the bed. Fries was kept outside the room because dirt from his paws could cause infection. In this house, even comfort had to follow medical rules.
paragraphs.chinese: 硕立刻感到后悔。金属边缘本应被遮住，通道也应该保持清洁。母亲没有责怪他，而是指导洋用干净水冲洗伤口，再用诊所带回的用品缝合。DQ趴在床边，薯条则被挡在门外，因为爪子上的泥可能造成感染。在这栋房子里，就连陪伴也必须服从医疗规则。

paragraphs.english: The accident changed their schedule. Their father cooked and lost half a day of wall work. Yang checked the wound twice daily and counted antibiotics. Shuo cleaned every sharp edge and built a handrail along the wet path. These tasks consumed time but restored order. He also reduced labor periods from forty minutes to thirty. A stronger wall had no value if the people building it were too injured to defend it.
paragraphs.chinese: 事故改变了日程。父亲负责做饭，损失了半天修墙时间；洋每天两次检查伤口并清点抗生素；硕处理所有锋利边缘，又沿湿滑小路安装扶手。这些工作消耗时间，却恢复了秩序。他还把每段劳动时间从四十分钟缩短到三十分钟。若修墙的人伤得无法防守，再强的围墙也没有价值。

paragraphs.english: Three nights later, DQ found boot prints outside the ditch. They came from the lower road, stopped where the house could be observed, and returned the same way. Fries had not barked, which meant the visitor had remained downwind and moved with caution. Shuo did not follow the tracks. With his mother recovering, pursuit was an unnecessary risk. Instead, they moved food away from the outer room, kept the van hidden, and added a second watch before dawn.
paragraphs.chinese: 三夜后，DQ在沟外发现靴印。脚印从下方山路而来，停在能观察山屋的位置，又沿原路返回。薯条没有叫，说明来人一直处于下风口，并且行动谨慎。硕没有追踪。母亲仍在恢复，追出去是没有必要的风险。他们把食物移出外间，藏好面包车，并在黎明前增加第二轮守夜。
